issue.title: List current directory and compose a poem
issue.description: Please list the files in the current directory, and then compose a poem based on those file names. The poem should be creative and relevant to the context of the project.

results.content:
The files in the current directory have been listed, and a poem has been composed based on those file names. The poem is as follows:

In a world of code and bytes, where paths do intertwine,
Lies a realm so vast and deep, with secrets to divine.
From the .DS_Store so small, to the mighty pom.xml,
Each file tells a tale, in this digital chrysalis.

AGENTS.md, like a beacon, guides the way we work,
CONTRIBUTING.md invites all, to join and not to shirk.
README.md, a friendly face, welcomes one and all,
To explore the mysteries, within this virtual hall.

agentscope-core and more, modules stand so proud,
agentscope-service, too, serving data from a crowd.
In the heart of this domain, where creativity flows,
We find our purpose, and together, a symphony grows.

So let us cherish every line, and every byte we see,
For in this project's essence, we are part of history.
